name: Espinelves (Spain)
description: Light green field charged with the three white thorns of the arms set two and one.
history: The council opened the adoption file on 30 May 2012 and the flag was approved on 28 November 2016 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is based on the arms, an oblong flag of 2:3, light green, with the three white thorns (espines) of the arms.

features.role: three thorns set two and one, each 13/48 of the height
